verdict.rationale: The evidence shows pinned pages being visible to agents each turn, scoped search, and list tools. Nothing documents a single call that returns a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories. Pinned-context injection and search are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call
